info.name: Agent Billing API 💰💰💰
info.description:
- Base URL: `https://payments.builtwith.com`
- Purpose: charge an existing account's saved Stripe method and add account API credits; this is not an x402 payment challenge.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_AGENT_BILLING_KEY`
- Setup: `https://payments.builtwith.com/agent-payment-api-config`
- Purchase rules: `Idempotency-Key` is required; credit quantities use fixed 2,000-credit increments; monthly limits reset on UTC calendar-month boundaries.
- `?KEY={{KEY}} is a deprecated compatibility mechanism and must not be used for new integrations.

Endpoints:
- `GET /v1/billing/api-discovery` - returns `credits_total`, `credits_used`, `credits_available`.
- `GET /v1/billing/api-configuration` - returns spending limits and monthly purchase status (`max_per_purchase`, `max_monthly`, `monthly_purchased`, `monthly_remaining`, `cost_per_2000_credits_usd`).
- `POST /v1/billing/api-purchase` - body `{"credits":2000}` plus a unique `Idempotency-Key`. Uses the account's saved Stripe payment method and configured spending limits.

### Legacy mppx Stripe Top-Up Path Aliases (Not x402)
- Base URL: `https://api.builtwith.com/mppx`
- Purpose: API-domain path aliases for the same saved-Stripe-method operations above; not an x402 or MPP payment-challenge protocol.
- Availability: requires manual enablement.
- Auth: same scoped Agent Billing Key as the primary service.
- Behavior: uses the same Stripe top-up service, spending limits, idempotency handling, and JSON errors.
- Discovery: `GET https://api.builtwith.com/mppx/openapi.json`

Endpoints:
- `GET /mppx/api-discovery` - alias for `/v1/billing/api-discovery`.
- `GET /mppx/api-configuration` - alias for `/v1/billing/api-configuration`.
- `POST /mppx/api-purchase` - alias for `/v1/billing/api-purchase`; body `{"credits":2000}`.
- Short aliases are also accepted: `/mppx/balance`, `/mppx/configuration`, and `/mppx/purchase`.

Updated 2026-11-10 from https://api.builtwith.com/llms-full.txt. Set KEY locally. Requests are examples; sending data requests may consume credits. Optional query parameters are disabled until selected.
